name: moa_loop_reference_messages
notes: Traced copy of moa_loop_wrappers.c::moa_u_reference_messages vs LIVE agent/moa_loop.py::_reference_messages. Inputs encode <scenario>\t<state>\t<result>; the twin maps the scenario to a synthetic conversation and derives both flags from LIVE behavior (asserting consistency, so an encoded flag that disagrees with LIVE fails loudly). The C wrapper models only two summary decisions (conversation present; trailing synthetic user appended) — its full advisory text is a fixed rendering and the per-message flattening ladder lives in the LIVE call.
